description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 8 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 levels 10 and 9 exceeded the resident-memory ceiling at larger prefix scope. PAQ8 level 8 should clear memory at 250K while preserving enough of the cmix21 text-mode archive advantage to remain a plausible frontier branch.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the next candidate after PAQ9 failed 250K memory.
